name: Overlay
description: A fixed-position semi-transparent backdrop used behind modals, drawers, and popovers. Marked aria-hidden as it is purely decorative.

notes: Always renders with aria-hidden='true' — it is a decorative backdrop.
Accessible labels and focus management are the responsibility of the containing dialog component.
The onClick handler enables closing parent components when the user clicks the backdrop.

transparent.description: When true, the overlay background becomes fully transparent. Useful for popovers that need click-outside behaviour without a visible backdrop.

onClick.description: Handler called when the backdrop is clicked. Used by parent components to close themselves.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the overlay element.

do: Always place Overlay behind the focused dialog content in the z-index stack.
Use the transparent variant when you need click-outside detection without a dimming effect.
dont: Do not place interactive content inside the Overlay element.
Do not rely on Overlay for scroll locking — that is the dialog component's responsibility.
